description: Validates then renders an ArchSmith diagram IR to a complete SVG document. Call get_schema and get_registry first to learn the required IR structure and governed vocabulary before authoring a document. Font embedding defaults to false to keep MCP responses compact; only opt in if the SVG must render portably without installed fonts — embedding adds a font subset sized to this diagram's own text, not a fixed cost, but it's still an added cost worth opting into deliberately. A render under 25,000 bytes is returned as one text content block; a larger one (e.g. a big diagram, or embedFonts:true on one) is returned as a resource_link instead, fetchable via resources/read, so the tool result itself never grows unbounded. Fails with the validation errors (isError: true) instead of rendering if the IR is invalid — never renders broken geometry from an invalid document.

embedFonts.description: Embed the bundled Arimo font for portable rendering, subset to just the glyphs this diagram's text needs (not the whole font). Default: false.

ir.description: The diagram IR document to render.

name: render
title: Render a diagram IR to SVG
